name.en: Grass Tiomos 110°, cranking 3, screw-on, cross plate H0 (Euro screws)
name.de: Grass Tiomos 110°, Kröpfung 3, zum Anschrauben, Kreuzmontageplatte H0 (Euroschrauben)

articles.note: cross mounting plate 37/32, 4-point, height 0, Euro screws 6.3

source: Grass Movement Systems catalogue 2026/27: mediacenter.grass.eu/Katalog/EN/508, 509 (overlay tables: cranking 3 A = 12 + TA − H), 594–596 (cup Ø35 × min. 12.6, TA 3–7 to the cup edge, hinges per door height), 580–582 (plates 37/32, heights 0/2/3). Alternative to the cranking-0 hinge on an H2 plate for a 1.5 mm side gap: here TA = A − 12 + 0. The 4-point plate's two small extra fixings (20/52 from the front edge) are not drilled; their Ø is not dimensioned in the catalogue.
